## Load packages

```{r setup}
pacman::p_load(here, limpa, limma, dplyr, tidyr, tibble, purrr, readxl, ggplot2, patchwork,
  writexl)
here::i_am("02_Differential_Expression/05_Response_Magnitude/a_script/05_response_magnitude.qmd")
set.seed(2026)
```

## Question

Protein by protein, BFR and HLRT training do not differ (no interaction hit in `02_Differential`).
A response can still be smaller overall, every protein moving the same way but less far, which no
single-protein test can see. Three tests ask that:

1. cross-fitted magnitude, as in the YvO Figure 4C: proteins chosen by one arm's response in half
   the participants, both arms' median |log2 change| measured in the other half;
2. a signature score: each leg's change projected onto the training direction learned from the
   other participants;
3. fry on the interaction contrast over the proteins that rise, and those that fall, with training.

Comparing hit counts (95 against 218) is not one of them: a difference in significance is not a
significant difference.

## Read changes

`proteins_adjusted.rds` gives each leg's change, T2 minus T1, with the blood index's effect
removed. Only participants with all four biopsies enter, so every comparison is within person.

```{r read}
stage <- here("02_Differential_Expression", "05_Response_Magnitude")
adjusted <- readRDS(here("01_Preprocess", "02_Quantification", "c_data", "proteins_adjusted.rds"))
complete <- adjusted$targets |>
  select(participant, treatment, timepoint, sample_id) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(treatment, timepoint), values_from = sample_id) |>
  drop_na()
bfr <- adjusted$E[, complete$BFR_T2] - adjusted$E[, complete$BFR_T1]
hlrt <- adjusted$E[, complete$HLRT_T2] - adjusted$E[, complete$HLRT_T1]
n <- nrow(complete)
hits <- read_excel(
  here("02_Differential_Expression", "02_Differential", "c_data", "02_differential.xlsx"),
  "contrast_summary"
)
bh_size <- c(
  BFR = hits$n_fdr_05[hits$contrast == "BFR_Post-Pre"],
  HLRT = hits$n_fdr_05[hits$contrast == "HLRT_Post-Pre"]
)
n
bh_size
```

## Cross-fitted magnitude

Choosing proteins by one arm and measuring that arm on the same people inflates it: a protein
enters partly because its estimate caught an upward noise draw. So each random split sends half
the participants to choose the proteins and the other half to measure both arms on them. Sets run
from all proteins to the top 500 and 250 and the BH set (as many proteins as the choosing arm's
BH hits), chosen once by HLRT and once by BFR, over 200 splits. The interval is the middle 95% of
splits. The swap p compares the ratio with 200 data sets in which each participant's BFR and HLRT
labels are swapped at random, the null that the two legs respond alike (10 splits each).

```{r crossfit}
crossfit <- function(bfr, hlrt, splits) {
  map(seq_len(splits), function(split) {
    half <- sample(n, n %/% 2)
    measured <- list(BFR = abs(rowMeans(bfr[, -half])), HLRT = abs(rowMeans(hlrt[, -half])))
    expand_grid(selected_on = c("HLRT", "BFR"), set = c("All", "Top 500", "Top 250", "BH")) |>
      mutate(
        size = case_when(
          set == "All" ~ nrow(bfr), set == "Top 500" ~ 500, set == "Top 250" ~ 250,
          .default = bh_size[selected_on]
        ),
        chosen = map2(selected_on, size, function(arm, size) {
          choose <- abs(rowMeans(list(BFR = bfr, HLRT = hlrt)[[arm]][, half]))
          rank(-choose, ties.method = "first") <= size
        }),
        bfr = map_dbl(chosen, function(k) median(measured$BFR[k])),
        hlrt = map_dbl(chosen, function(k) median(measured$HLRT[k]))
      ) |>
      select(-chosen)
  }) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    mutate(ratio = bfr / hlrt)
}
split_results <- crossfit(bfr, hlrt, 200)
swapped <- map(seq_len(200), function(i) {
  flip <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), n, replace = TRUE)
  b <- bfr; h <- hlrt
  b[, flip] <- hlrt[, flip]
  h[, flip] <- bfr[, flip]
  summarise(crossfit(b, h, 10), null_ratio = median(ratio), .by = c(selected_on, set))
}) |>
  list_rbind()
magnitude <- split_results |>
  summarise(
    conf.low = quantile(ratio, 0.025), conf.high = quantile(ratio, 0.975),
    size = first(size), bfr = median(bfr), hlrt = median(hlrt), ratio = median(ratio),
    .by = c(selected_on, set)
  ) |>
  left_join(summarise(swapped, nulls = list(null_ratio), .by = c(selected_on, set)),
    by = c("selected_on", "set")) |>
  mutate(swap_p = map2_dbl(nulls, ratio, function(null, r) {
    (1 + sum(abs(log(null)) >= abs(log(r)))) / (1 + length(null))
  })) |>
  select(-nulls)
mutate(magnitude, across(where(is.double), function(x) signif(x, 3)))
```

## Signature score

The training direction is the mean change across both arms. For each participant it is learned
from the other participants only, over a set fixed before any comparison: the proteins whose
average training change across both arms passes BH 0.05 in the limpa model (below). Each leg's
score is its change projected onto that direction; 1 means it moved as far as the average leg of
the others. BFR against HLRT is then a paired comparison of one number per participant, tested
with a paired t and with 5,000 random sign flips of the per-participant differences.

```{r average-fit}
proteins <- readRDS(here("01_Preprocess", "02_Quantification", "c_data", "proteins.rds"))
d <- readRDS(here("02_Differential_Expression", "01_Design", "c_data", "design.rds"))
coefficient_fit <- dpcDE(proteins, d$design, plot = FALSE)
average <- makeContrasts(average = (BFR_T2 - BFR_T1 + HLRT_T2 - HLRT_T1) / 2, levels = d$design)
average_fit <- topTable(eBayes(contrasts.fit(coefficient_fit, average), robust = TRUE),
  number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
training_set <- list(
  up = rownames(average_fit)[average_fit$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & average_fit$logFC > 0],
  down = rownames(average_fit)[average_fit$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & average_fit$logFC < 0]
)
lengths(training_set)
```

```{r signature}
signature_rows <- rownames(bfr) %in% unlist(training_set)
signature_scores <- map(seq_len(n), function(i) {
  direction <- rowMeans((bfr + hlrt)[signature_rows, -i] / 2)
  tibble(
    participant = complete$participant[i],
    BFR = sum(bfr[signature_rows, i] * direction) / sum(direction^2),
    HLRT = sum(hlrt[signature_rows, i] * direction) / sum(direction^2)
  )
}) |>
  list_rbind()
difference <- signature_scores$BFR - signature_scores$HLRT
flips <- replicate(5000, mean(difference * sample(c(-1, 1), n, replace = TRUE)))
signature_test <- tibble(
  test = "signature score", proteins = sum(signature_rows),
  bfr = mean(signature_scores$BFR), hlrt = mean(signature_scores$HLRT),
  ratio = bfr / hlrt, p = t.test(difference)$p.value,
  swap_p = mean(abs(flips) >= abs(mean(difference)))
)
signature_test
```

## fry on the interaction

If BFR responds less, the proteins that rise with training rise less in BFR, so their interaction
(BFR change minus HLRT change) leans negative, and those that fall lean positive. fry tests each set
as a whole in the limpa model with the blood covariate, allowing for correlation between proteins.
Choosing sets by the average of the two arms does not bias the interaction, because swapping a
participant's legs leaves the average unchanged.

```{r fry}
interaction <- d$contrasts[, "Modality_x_Time_Interaction"]
interaction_change <- contrasts.fit(coefficient_fit, cbind(interaction))$coefficients[, 1]
proteins$weights <- coefficient_fit$EList$weights
fry_test <- fry(proteins, training_set, d$design, interaction, robust = TRUE, sort = "none") |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "set") |>
  mutate(
    median_training = map_dbl(training_set, function(rows) median(average_fit[rows, "logFC"])),
    median_interaction = map_dbl(training_set, function(rows) median(interaction_change[rows]))
  )
fry_test
```

## Figure

Cross-fitted median |log2 change| per arm, chosen by HLRT (left) and by BFR (right), with the BFR
to HLRT ratio and swap p above each pair; below, each participant's two signature scores.

```{r figure}
#| fig-height: 9
arm_colours <- c(BFR = "#D55E00", HLRT = "#0072B2")
bars <- magnitude |>
  mutate(
    set = factor(set, c("All", "Top 500", "Top 250", "BH")),
    selected_on = factor(paste("Chosen by", selected_on), c("Chosen by HLRT", "Chosen by BFR")),
    label = sprintf("%.2f\np %.2f", ratio, swap_p)
  )
magnitude_plot <- bars |>
  pivot_longer(c(bfr, hlrt), names_to = "arm", values_to = "magnitude") |>
  mutate(arm = toupper(arm)) |>
  ggplot(aes(set, magnitude, fill = arm)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = bars, aes(set, pmax(bfr, hlrt), label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.3, size = 2.5, lineheight = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~selected_on) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = arm_colours) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.25))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Median |log2 change|, held-out half", fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9)
signature_plot <- signature_scores |>
  pivot_longer(c(BFR, HLRT), names_to = "arm", values_to = "score") |>
  ggplot(aes(arm, score, group = participant)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey80") +
  geom_line(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = arm), size = 1.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = arm_colours) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Signature score",
    subtitle = sprintf("BFR/HLRT %.2f, paired p %.3f, swap p %.3f", signature_test$ratio,
      signature_test$p, signature_test$swap_p)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9)
page <- magnitude_plot / (signature_plot | plot_spacer()) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Training response magnitude, BFR against HLRT")
page

pdf(file.path(stage, "b_reports", "05_response_magnitude.pdf"), width = 8.27, height = 9)
print(page)
invisible(dev.off())
```

## Save results

```{r write}
write_xlsx(
  list(
    magnitude = magnitude,
    signature_scores = signature_scores,
    tests = bind_rows(
      signature_test,
      transmute(fry_test, test = paste("fry", set), proteins = NGenes, median_training,
        median_interaction, direction = Direction, p = PValue)
    )
  ),
  file.path(stage, "c_data", "05_response_magnitude.xlsx")
)
```
